title: QE NEB Context Provider Schema
description: Schema for QENEBContextProvider that generates context data for Quantum ESPRESSO pw.x NEB input. Extends the pw.x context with image-specific atomic positions.

IBRAV.description: Bravais lattice index. Context provider version (uppercase) of ibrav from &SYSTEM.

ATOMIC_SPECIES.description: Formatted text block for ATOMIC_SPECIES card. Format: 'X Mass_X PseudoPot_X' per line. Corresponds to ATOMIC_SPECIES section in pw.x input.

ATOMIC_SPECIES_WITH_LABELS.description: Formatted text block for ATOMIC_SPECIES card with element labels (e.g., Fe1, C1). Format: 'Xn Mass_X PseudoPot_X' per line

NAT.description: Number of atoms in the unit cell. Context provider version (uppercase) of nat from &SYSTEM.

NTYP.description: Number of different atomic species (unique elements). Context provider version (uppercase) of ntyp from &SYSTEM.

NTYP_WITH_LABELS.description: Number of different atomic species including labels

ATOMIC_POSITIONS.description: Formatted text block for ATOMIC_POSITIONS card WITH constraints for a given image. Format: 'X x y z [if_pos(1) if_pos(2) if_pos(3)]' per line.

ATOMIC_POSITIONS_WITHOUT_CONSTRAINTS.description: Formatted text block for ATOMIC_POSITIONS card WITHOUT constraints for a given image. Format: 'X x y z' per line

CELL_PARAMETERS.description: Formatted text block for CELL_PARAMETERS card. Three lines, each containing three space-separated numbers representing lattice vectors.

FIRST_IMAGE.description: Atomic positions block (ATOMIC_POSITIONS) for the first NEB image.

LAST_IMAGE.description: Atomic positions block (ATOMIC_POSITIONS) for the last NEB image.

INTERMEDIATE_IMAGES.description: Atomic positions blocks (ATOMIC_POSITIONS) for all intermediate NEB images.
